newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices mixed in slow activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices mixed in slow activity.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mixed on Wednesday in fairly slow activity, dealers said.
But some brokers in several Midwest locations noted an improvement in nearby demand for spot feed.
"Nearby demand was moderately stronger," a St. Louis dealer said. St Louis spot values were bid at $94.00 a ton and offered at $97.00, a gain of one dollar.
Buffalo spot prices stood at $95.00 a ton on the bid side and $96.00 a ton on the offer side, a rise of seven to six dollars respectively.
One Texas dealer said he saw nearby interest for feed.
Wet conditions in parts of the Midwest and snow which covered northeast Kansas, southeast Nebraska, southwest Iowa and northwest Missouri on Tuesday spurred some nearby business, dealers said.
Rain in Minnesota has prevented farmers from doing fieldwork and given them time to take care of feed business, a Minneapolis dealer said.
